title: 「In that sense」從這個角度來說
titleEn: Using in that sense to draw a conclusion from a stated perspective

source.file: Sentence Structure 131 - 「In that sense」從這個角度來說.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Idea / Fact 1. In that sense, + interpretation or conclusion

formulas.formula: Idea / Fact 1. In that sense, + interpretation or conclusion

example: Cooking teaches patience. In that sense, it is more than just preparing food.
exampleZh: 烹飪能培養耐心。從這個角度來說，它不只是準備食物。

examples.en: Cooking teaches patience. In that sense, it is more than just preparing food.
examples.zh: 烹飪能培養耐心。從這個角度來說，它不只是準備食物。

rules.zh: 前面必須先有一個完整觀點 In that sense 不能在沒有背景的情況下突然出現。前一句必須先提出一項事實、理由或觀察。
rules.en: A complete idea must be stated before in that sense. The phrase cannot appear abruptly without context; the previous sentence must first provide a fact, reason or observation.
examples: Reading helps us understand other people’s experiences. In that sense, it develops empathy.

rules.zh: 句首使用時，後面要加逗號
rules.en: When used initially, in that sense is followed by a comma.
examples: In that sense, failure can be useful.

rules.zh: 它表示「從剛才提到的角度來說」 它通常不是表示一個絕對適用於所有情況的結論，而是表示：只按照前一句所提出的觀點來看， 這個結論是合理的。 這並不是說人工智能在所有方面都與人類一樣智能。
rules.en: It means ‘from the perspective just mentioned’. The conclusion is usually not claimed to hold absolutely in every situation; it is reasonable only when viewed through the point made in the preceding sentence. Thus the example does not claim that artificial intelligence is intelligent in every respect in the same way as a human.
examples: Artificial intelligence can recognise patterns quickly. In that sense, it is intelligent.

rules.zh: 不要把它當作單純的 therefore Therefore 通常強調直接的因果結果。 In that sense 則強調「按照上述角度作出的理解」。
rules.en: Do not treat it as a simple synonym for therefore. Therefore normally signals a direct causal result, whereas in that sense introduces an interpretation made from the perspective just established.
examples: It rained heavily. Therefore, the match was cancelled.
Reading requires us to imagine other people’s lives. In that sense, it is an exercise in empathy.

rules.zh: 與相似句型的分別 功能：回指前一句，並作出角度性的總結或詮釋。 常見格式： 功能：直接解釋某個字眼、形容或說法具體是甚麼意思。 它不是先提出一個觀點再作總結，而是直接說明前面的 flexible 到底指甚麼。 功能：指出某事物具有某種特點的原因或具體表現，意思接近「因為」或「在於」。 Quick Comparison 快速比較 先提出一個觀點，再從該角度作出結論。 直接解釋「flexible」的具體意思。 說明這份工作為甚麼特別或具有某種特點。
rules.en: Distinguish it from related expressions that define meaning or give reasons. In that sense refers back to a complete earlier idea and offers a perspective-based summary or interpretation. In the sense that directly explains the exact meaning of a preceding word or description rather than first stating an idea and then drawing a conclusion. In that identifies the reason for, or particular respect in which, a description is true. In short: in that sense states an idea and then draws a conclusion from that angle; in the sense that defines what a description means; and in that explains why something has a particular feature.
examples: The company lets employees choose their working hours. In that sense, it is flexible.
The company is flexible in the sense that employees can choose their working hours.
The exam was challenging in that it required critical thinking rather than memorisation.

benefits.zh: 清楚顯示你的思考角度 這個句型能清楚告訴讀者：你的結論是根據前面哪一個觀點得出的。
benefits.en: It clearly shows the perspective from which you are reasoning by identifying exactly which earlier idea supports the conclusion.

benefits.zh: 幫助你由「事實」發展成「分析」 你可以先提出一項事實，再說明這項事實代表甚麼，而不只是列出資料。 第一句是觀察，第二句則把觀察發展成分析。
benefits.en: It helps develop a fact into analysis. You can state an observation and then explain what it signifies instead of merely listing information; the first sentence supplies the observation and the second develops it analytically.
examples: Good leaders listen carefully. In that sense, leadership is a communication skill.

benefits.zh: 避免把結論說得過於絕對 In that sense 表示結論是在某個特定角度下成立，因此能讓說法更加準確。 這不等於聲稱人工智能在所有方面都擁有人類智慧。
benefits.en: It prevents conclusions from sounding too absolute because in that sense limits the conclusion to a particular perspective. It does not, for example, claim that artificial intelligence possesses human intelligence in every respect.

benefits.zh: 令兩個句子連接得更自然 你不需要把兩個觀點生硬地放在一起。這個句型能帶領讀者由第一個觀點自然過渡到第二個觀 點。
benefits.en: It connects two sentences naturally. Rather than placing two ideas together without showing their relationship, the phrase guides readers smoothly from the first point to the second.

benefits.zh: 適合用於口語、作文、報告和討論 這是一個容易套用的表達框架： 掌握這個框架後，你可以更有條理地解釋抽象觀點，而不必每次都重複使用 therefore、so 或 from this point of view。
benefits.en: It is useful in speech, essays, reports and discussions. The reusable frame ‘Fact or observation → In that sense → interpretation’ helps you explain abstract ideas systematically without repeatedly using therefore, so or from this point of view.
